notes: MutualFunToken (src/MutualFunToken.sol) is a fixed-supply OpenZeppelin ERC20 named The mutual fun (TMF) with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 TMF (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, the ProjectFactory, which distributes it. There is no owner, no further minting, no burn, no pause, no blacklist, no fee or tax on transfer, no proxy and no upgrade path; every transfer moves exactly the amount requested, so the swarm share, the pool seed, claims and swaps all arrive whole. The launch deploys no application contracts. The pool pairs with IMD at the launch policy's 1.25% fee; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the supply, so pool.initialPrice is provenance only.
